questions.q_en: What is special about your bioreactor?
questions.q_zh: 你們的生物反應器特別在哪裡？
kw_en: US$1,022 of parts, all files public
questions.a_en: Two circuits that touch only at the fibre wall: a culture loop closed for the whole run, and a shell-side harvest path that is the only thing leaving the machine. Harvest is on demand rather than a continuous bleed — closing the pinch valve and opening the shell valve for sixty seconds lifts mean transmembrane pressure from 0.03 to 0.16 bar and yields twenty to thirty millilitres without interrupting the culture. We read OD600, pH, flow and three pressures in line through a 116-hour run without opening the vessel, and the pH loop taught us something the vessel alone could not: holding pH and resupplying erythromycin together removed the spurious second exponential phase. Every build file, STL and parts list is published, and the known materials come to US$1,022.67.
questions.a_zh: 兩個迴路只在纖維壁這一處相接：一個整場密閉的培養迴路，以及殼側那條唯一會離開機器的採收路徑。採收是隨需而不是持續排放——關上夾管閥、打開殼側閥六十秒，平均跨膜壓從 0.03 升到 0.16 bar，可以在不中斷培養的情況下取得二十到三十毫升。我們在一次 116 小時的實驗裡全程線上讀 OD600、pH、流量和三個壓力，而且沒有打開容器；pH 這個迴路教了我們一件單看容器學不到的事：同時維持 pH 和補充紅黴素，才讓那個假的第二指數期消失。所有組裝檔、STL 和零件清單都公開，已知的材料成本是 US$1,022.67。
questions.trap_en: Calling it novel. Hollow-fibre perfusion is not new; what is ours is production, recovery and containment as one unit operation at 1 L with instruments we had to build.
questions.trap_zh: 說它很新穎。中空纖維灌流不是新東西；屬於我們的是「在 1 L 尺度上，生產、回收和圍阻是同一個單元操作，而儀器是我們自己做的」。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: You integrated a pH sensor. What have you learned from it, and what does it bring to your results on top of the OD?
questions.q_zh: 你們裝了 pH 感測器。從它身上學到什麼？除了 OD 之外它給了你們什麼？
kw_en: a control variable, not a monitor
kw_zh: 是控制變數不是監看值
要補的不只是鹼，還有抗生素
questions.a_en: It turned pH from something we watched into something we hold. With all sensors working in cycle 3, pH fell monotonically from about 6.9 to 6.4, and superimposing the growth curve showed the OD600 inflection sitting exactly where pH crossed 6.5 — below which both Bacillus subtilis growth and the enzyme's stability suffer — so automated correction became a design requirement. The loop then taught us two more things: 1 molar potassium hydroxide corroded the feeding valve after one night, so dosing went back to a human, and because the daily feed carried erythromycin alongside base, the spurious second exponential phase disappeared, which is what identified it as plasmid loss rather than a metabolic transition. pH also cross-checks the OD: when the pump ran partly dry the OD600 climbed while flow and pressure did not follow, so a rise without its partners is now read as a hydraulic fault and not as growth.
questions.a_zh: 它把 pH 從「我們在看的東西」變成「我們在維持的東西」。第三個循環所有感測器都正常時，pH 從大約 6.9 單調下降到 6.4，而把生長曲線疊上去之後，OD600 的轉折點正好落在 pH 跨過 6.5 的地方——在那之下 B. subtilis 的生長和酵素的結構穩定性都會受損——所以自動校正成為設計要求。接著這個迴路又教了我們兩件事：1 M 氫氧化鉀一個晚上就把進料閥腐蝕了，所以加鹼又回到人工；而因為每天的補料同時帶了紅黴素，那個假的第二指數期消失了，這才確認它是質體流失而不是代謝轉換。pH 也用來交叉檢查 OD：當泵半乾運轉時 OD600 會往上爬，但流量和壓力沒有跟著動，所以現在「上升但夥伴訊號沒跟上」被讀成水力故障，不是生長。
questions.trap_en: Saying it keeps the culture healthy. The specific findings are the 6.5 inflection, the corroded valve that ended automated dosing, and that antibiotic resupply was the real requirement.
questions.trap_zh: 只說「它讓培養保持健康」。具體發現是 6.5 的轉折點、被腐蝕而導致自動加藥停止的閥，以及真正的要求其實是補抗生素。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: What would you do if the bacteria leaked?
questions.q_zh: 如果細菌洩漏了，你們會怎麼做？
questions.a_en: It has already happened, and the useful part is that we traced it. In integrated prototype 3 a Luer valve at the start of the lumen loop broke in half at the thirty-eight-hour mark and culture medium leaked into the incubator; the membrane did not fail, and we traced the break to the clean-in-place step, where 35 percent hydrogen peroxide reaches the valves before it is diluted in the reservoir. The response is BSL-1 standard: contain inside the incubator with the spill kit, disinfect with ten percent bleach, autoclave the solid waste at 121 degrees for fifteen to thirty minutes, and plate the shell side to confirm the barrier. The design answers are specified — an oxidiser-resistant valve body, a droplet sensor under the loop, and a pressure trip that stops the pump and opens the pinch valve — and I should be clear that our containment evidence is two single platings with no replicate and no recorded detection limit, so we claim retention demonstrated and not a log reduction.
questions.a_zh: 這件事已經發生過了，而有價值的部分是我們把原因追出來。在整合第三代原型，lumen 迴路起點的一個 Luer 閥在 38 小時斷成兩半，培養液漏進培養箱裡；膜沒有失效，而我們把斷裂追到清洗（CIP）步驟——35% 過氧化氫在被反應槽稀釋之前就會先經過那些閥。處置是 BSL-1 標準：用溢漏處理包在培養箱內圍堵、用 10% 漂白水消毒、固體廢棄物 121 度高壓滅菌 15 到 30 分鐘，並且塗盤殼側來確認屏障。設計上的答案也都寫明了——耐氧化劑的閥體、迴路下方的液滴感測器，以及會停泵並打開夾管閥的壓力跳脫——而我必須講清楚：我們的圍阻證據是兩次單一塗盤，沒有重複、也沒有記錄偵測極限，所以我們主張的是「已展示滯留」，不是 log reduction。
questions.trap_en: Answering only with a procedure. Lead with the leak that actually happened and what it was traced to; a judge rates the diagnosis above the SOP.
questions.trap_zh: 只回答一套流程。要先講真正發生過的那次洩漏以及追到的原因；評審看重診斷能力勝過 SOP。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: You say the similar ELISA values may come from light leaking between neighbouring light-plate wells. The whole selling point of that plate is independently programmable wells. Which claim do you drop?
questions.q_zh: 你們說 ELISA 值相近可能是因為光板相鄰孔之間的光外洩。但那塊板子的賣點就是每個孔可以獨立程控。你們要放棄哪一個主張？
kw_zh: 獨立驅動 vs 光學隔離
questions.a_en: Neither, because they are different claims: every well has its own LED and its own duty cycle, which is the electronics, while whether a lit well spills photons into its neighbour is mechanical shielding. Both can be true at once, and ours is an open rack of tubes rather than a sealed microplate, so spill between positions is exactly the failure mode you would predict from the geometry. It is also measurable in an afternoon — put an empty tube next to a well at 100 percent and read the irradiance in it, which is the test we have not run. Until we do, the honest version is that we offer light crosstalk as an untested explanation, and the page says so.
questions.a_zh: 兩個都不用放棄，因為它們是不同的主張：每個孔有自己的 LED 和自己的工作週期，那是電子部分；而一個亮著的孔會不會把光子灑到鄰孔，那是機構遮光。兩件事可以同時成立，而我們的是開放式的試管架、不是密封的微孔盤，所以位置之間的外洩正是從幾何上就會預期到的失效模式。這件事一個下午就能量——在一個開到 100% 的孔旁邊放一支空管，讀裡面的輻照度，而這個測試我們還沒做。在做之前，誠實的版本是「我們把光外洩當成一個未經驗證的解釋提出來」，頁面上也是這樣寫的。
questions.trap_en: Defending the plate by dropping the crosstalk explanation, or vice versa. Separating independent drive from optical isolation is the answer.
questions.trap_zh: 為了保住板子而放棄光外洩的解釋，或反過來。把「獨立驅動」和「光學隔離」分開講才是答案。

questions.q_en: Your bioreactor page gives 0.037 milliunits per millilitre at eighteen hours and your Results page gives about 30 nanomoles per millilitre per hour for the same sample. Those differ by a factor of roughly a thousand. Which is right?
questions.q_zh: 你們生物反應器頁寫 18 小時 0.037 mU/mL，Results 頁對同一個樣品寫大約 30 nmol/mL/h。這兩個差了大約一千倍。哪一個才對？
kw_en: specific activity only works with the larger value
kw_zh: 反應器那張圖的單位錯了
比活性只有用大的那個才算得通
questions.a_en: The larger value is right and the bioreactor page's activity panel is wrong by three orders of magnitude; thank you for finding it, because we would rather name it than be caught by it. The arithmetic settles it: specific activity on that same figure is 6.3 units per milligram at eighteen hours, and that only comes out if the volumetric activity is about 30 nanomoles per millilitre per hour against roughly 6 micrograms per millilitre of protein, not 0.037 milliunits. Results is the authority for the assay numbers, because it carries the standard curves and the full nine-point series. The page needs a correction and it is on our list; nothing downstream depends on the smaller number, because the claim we make from that run is that functional enzyme appears at eighteen hours and holds between 5 and 8.4 units per milligram to seventy-two.
questions.a_zh: 大的那個才對，生物反應器頁的活性面板錯了三個數量級；謝謝你找出來，因為我們寧願自己講出來，也不要被抓到。用算術就能定案：同一張圖上 18 小時的比活性是 6.3 U/mg，而這個數字只有在體積活性約 30 nmol/mL/h、蛋白約 6 微克每毫升的情況下才算得出來，不可能是 0.037 mU/mL。assay 的數字以 Results 頁為準，因為標準曲線和完整的九點系列都在那裡。那一頁需要更正，已經在我們的清單上；下游沒有任何東西依賴那個小數字，因為我們從那次實驗做出的主張是「有功能的酵素在 18 小時出現，並且維持在 5 到 8.4 U/mg 直到 72 小時」。
questions.trap_en: Trying to reconcile the two numbers. One is a typo; say which page is the authority and move on.
questions.trap_zh: 試著把兩個數字湊起來解釋。其中一個就是寫錯了；說清楚哪一頁是準的，然後往前走。

questions.q_en: Your leak happened at the lowest-pressure point in the loop, and the lumen pressure rose instead of falling. If pressure cannot see a leak, what is your planned pressure layer actually protecting you from?
questions.q_zh: 你們的洩漏發生在迴路壓力最低的地方，而且 lumen 壓力是上升而不是下降。如果壓力看不到洩漏，那你們規劃的壓力那一層到底在防什麼？
kw_zh: 進料 0.19 到 0.37 bar，TMP 不變
questions.a_en: The pressure layer prevents a breach rather than detecting one, and the leak is why we can state that precisely. When the feeding valve failed, feed pressure climbed from about 0.19 to 0.37 bar while transmembrane pressure showed no significant change, so the pressure signature is diagnostic only in combination with flow and the other channels, never on its own. What over-pressure does protect against is the condition most likely to force cells through a damaged fibre or burst a fitting: past a threshold the controller sounds an alarm, stops the culture pump and opens the pinch valve, before anything escapes. Detecting liquid that has already escaped is the droplet sensor's job, which is layer two and is one new part, and a fault neither layer can see is still caught the way it is caught today, by plating the shell side.
questions.a_zh: 壓力這一層是在預防破口，不是在偵測破口，而正因為發生過那次洩漏，我們才能把這件事講精確。進料閥失效時，進料壓力從大約 0.19 升到 0.37 bar，而跨膜壓沒有明顯變化，所以壓力特徵只有在和流量及其他通道一起看時才有診斷力，單獨看沒有。過壓真正防的是「最可能把細胞推過受損纖維、或讓接頭爆開」的那個狀況：超過閾值時控制器會發警報、停下培養泵、打開夾管閥——在任何東西逸出之前。偵測已經逸出的液體是液滴感測器的工作，那是第二層、只需要一個新零件；而兩層都看不到的故障，仍然用今天的方法抓：塗盤殼側。
questions.trap_en: Claiming pressure monitoring detects loss of containment. The run shows the opposite, and the page says a dedicated leak detector is required.
questions.trap_zh: 說壓力監測可以偵測圍阻失效。那次實驗顯示的正好相反，頁面也寫了需要專門的洩漏偵測裝置。

questions.q_en: Your refill plan ships a spore cartridge at room temperature. Have you shown WB800 sporulates, germinates, and keeps a 10 kilobase plasmid through that?
questions.q_zh: 你們的補充卡匣計畫是常溫運送孢子。你們證明過 WB800 會形成孢子、能發芽，而且在這個過程中保住 10 kb 的質體嗎？
kw_en: no, it is declared future work
the printed parts were not watertight
kw_zh: 沒有，是列出來的未來工作
questions.a_en: No, and the page lists it as future work rather than as a result. Three things are owed before a cartridge exists: a reliable seal, because the printed parts were not watertight and it needs moulded parts or O-ring glands; sterility across repeated changeovers; and confirmation that the strain sporulates and germinates reliably from stored spores. Plasmid retention through sporulation is the one you are pointing at and it is the hardest, because our device plasmid is about 10 kilobases and we already know what that size costs us at the wall — electroporation had to be worked out per construct, down to 1.1 kilovolts for some of them. A genomic integration would remove the problem entirely and that is the direction we would take it, which also means the cartridge is a design, not a demonstration.
questions.a_zh: 沒有，頁面上把它列為未來工作而不是結果。在卡匣真的存在之前還欠三件事：可靠的密封，因為印出來的件不防水，需要射出成型的件或 O 形環槽；多次更換之間的無菌性；以及確認這株菌能從儲存的孢子穩定地形成並發芽。你指的「質體保留」是最難的那一項，因為我們的裝置質體大約 10 kb，而我們已經知道這個大小在細胞壁上的代價——電穿孔必須一個構築一個構築去調，有些甚至要降到 1.1 kV。把基因整合到基因體上可以完全移除這個問題，那也是我們會走的方向；這同時意味著卡匣目前是一個設計，不是一個展示。
questions.trap_en: Describing how the cartridge would work as if it had been built. Say it is a design, then name the three things owed.
questions.trap_zh: 把卡匣的運作方式講得像已經做出來。要說它是一個設計，然後講出還欠的三件事。
